label: Workday Plan
description: Model-authored planning node. Receives a validated spec and emits a plan draft. Transitions with owner=model; the emitted plan carries a proposal tag and must be disposed by a script before entering an authority state.

inputs.name: spec
inputs.description: Validated spec record from the scribe or human intake

outputs.name: plan_draft
outputs.description: Model-authored plan draft. Tagged as a proposal — must be disposed by a script before reaching an authority input.
